From: Dr. Lina Morales <lina.morales@utnorth.edu>

Subject: Request: compute subsidy for SocialVoice (course + research pilot)

Hi Vivek / Marissa,

I hope you’re both well. I run the Center for Responsible AI at University of Northern. We’re teaching a new senior-studio course, SocialVoice, that trains students to build small multimodal agents and evaluate social impact. The class runs July–December and we expect to spin up ~40 student projects, plus a small research group (3 students + 1 PI) doing larger-scale experiments.

We started a short trial with Redwood and it’s been promising for our pedagogical workflows, but our grant budget requires a formal credit allocation and an invoice for accounting. Would Redwood consider a semester-long academic subsidy (we’re requesting a 6-month trial extension and $5,000 in platform credits) tied to the SocialVoice project? We can provide a PO and a short project outline (attached). Key asks:
- Credits applied to a single project/org so we can track usage for the grant
- A billing invoice for grant reporting
- Short onboarding to set per-project quotas so students don’t run away with costs

We’ll also note this work will be used in a conference submission in Q1 2028 (we will attribute Redwood). Happy to jump on a quick call if easier.

Thanks,

Dr. Lina Morales
Director, Center for Responsible AI
University of Northern

Hi Lina — thanks for the note and the outline, it looks like a great course. Two quick clarifying questions so I can loop in Sales Ops and our Academic Programs lead:
1) Rough estimate of monthly token / GPU-hours budget for the research group vs. the class (ballpark okay).
2) Will any student data include PII or protected health information? If so we’ll surface the right controls.
3) Do you have a PO number or the university invoice contact we should send paperwork to?

I’ll ask Marissa to propose an academic promo package; if we can get a PO we can get finance to issue the invoice you need for the grant. If helpful, we can provision a single "SocialVoice" project and tag usage for reporting.

—Vivek
